text.name: copy / introduction
text.text: Load a firmware file from your computer. Run independent sessions to compare builds, inspect execution and exchange virtual USB reports.

text.name: copy / researchLimit
text.text: Research build. Peripheral coverage is incomplete. Results here need separate hardware verification for boot, recovery, audio and firmware updates.

text.name: copy / localNote
text.text: Firmware stays in this browser. The runtime downloads when you press Start. This page has no connection to a physical SP.

text.name: copy / instrumentCaption
text.text: The OLED shows firmware output. Control inputs inject recorded GPIO, ADC and UART paths; pressure and audio remain incomplete.

text.name: copy / formatNote
text.text: APP1 starts at the application handoff. Full flash starts at resident entry. ROM and DCD execution are not included.

text.name: copy / traceNote
text.text: JSON with firmware identity, execution and model limits.

text.name: copy / controlNote
text.text: Hold a pad with a pointer, Enter or Space. These injected levels test firmware input paths; they do not reproduce physical velocity or calibrated pressure.

text.name: copy / inputNote
text.text: For buttons, 1 is held and 0 is released. Knob and pad values are normalized model inputs.

text.name: copy / usbNote
text.text: Send a 64-byte hexadecimal HID report to this session’s emulated firmware, or read its current USB status. USB support depends on the loaded build and the peripheral model.
